narrative.overview: User-selected dark espresso with warm sunset glow. Retro gradients and subtle glows are explicit requirements. Bricolage Grotesque headings, Instrument Sans working text and Instrument Serif auth accents support a compact research workspace.
keyCharacteristics: Espresso surfaces and warm cream text

rules.name: Sunset requirement
rules.body: Preserve the user-requested retro gradients and warm glows.

rules.name: Working text
rules.body: Miniature board illustration text is not a working typography token.

dos: Use the final retro.css cascade as theme authority.
Keep source inspection and explicit approval legible.

Do extend the espresso and sunset system for saved chats, insights, sync, team forms, discussions, and roadmap ownership; keep labels, evidence links, metadata, and selected states readable at stacked breakpoints.
donts: Do not restore the previous sage and warm-light palette.
Do not rebuild functional layouts as full-page decorative specimens.
